routing.scope: Adult Part 3. Use Part 1 relationship, Service, status, dependant and deployment-return answers; do not use superseded local questionnaire fields.

upstream_inputs.Q3: Role IDs: unmarried_member, married_member, civilian_spouse, civilian_partner, former_bereaved_partner, adult_child, parent, other_family, another_connection, none.
upstream_inputs.Q4: Service IDs: army, navy, air_force, other_country, unsure, none.
upstream_inputs.Q5: Focal service status IDs: permanent, reserves, continuous_full_time_reserve, former, deceased, other_status, unsure.
upstream_inputs.Q6: Respondent's spouse/partner military-status IDs: never_served, veteran, permanent, reserves, continuous_full_time_reserve, unsure.
upstream_inputs.Q8: Six dependant age bands and two count columns, plus no_dependants.
upstream_inputs.Q9: Self-reporting member's return from deployment within the past year.
upstream_inputs.Q10: Partner/family deployment-return answer; its referent depends on the respondent's role.

execution.and: false if any operand is false; true if all operands are true; otherwise unknown.
execution.or: true if any operand is true; false if all operands are false; otherwise unknown.
execution.show_if: All items require affirmative adult consent. A true gate displays the item. A false gate hides it. An unknown gate keeps a potentially applicable item available and optional unless the item explicitly requires an affirmative triggering answer.
execution.explicit_yes: True only for an active yes answer. No, skipped and inapplicable all fail this display trigger but remain distinct stored states.
execution.explicit_retirement: True only for an active retiring_soon selection. A skipped preference question does not establish retirement.
execution.text_scope: Only labels, option labels, help_text, applicability_text, page text and thank_you text are respondent-facing. Gate descriptions and metadata are not.
execution.multi_select_limit: No additional selection cap unless a question explicitly supplies one.
execution.write_in: Display only for the selected option. An option-label reference labels the write-in without adding another visible prompt. Write-ins are optional.
execution.numbering: Display original question numbers once; source IDs and variant IDs remain metadata.

derived_fields.is_member: True for Q3 unmarried_member or married_member; false for known spouse/other-family roles; unknown for another_connection, none or skipped.
derived_fields.is_spouse: True for Q3 civilian_spouse or civilian_partner; false for known member/other-family roles; unknown for another_connection, none or skipped.
derived_fields.is_other_family: True for Q3 former_bereaved_partner, adult_child, parent or other_family; false for known member/spouse roles; otherwise unknown.
derived_fields.member_or_spouse: is_member OR is_spouse. Known other-family roles do not qualify merely because the respondent is married.
derived_fields.current_partner: Map the active Part 1 current_partner_status yes/no/unknown to true/false/unknown. Do not infer no partner from unmarried_member alone.
derived_fields.focal_current_service: True when active Q5 includes permanent, reserves or continuous_full_time_reserve; false when Q5 establishes former or deceased without a conflicting current selection; otherwise unknown. Another service status alone is not automatically current or former.
derived_fields.focal_deceased: True only when active Q5 establishes deceased.
derived_fields.focal_former: True when active Q5 establishes former and not deceased.
derived_fields.partner_military_service: True when active Q6 includes veteran, permanent, reserves or continuous_full_time_reserve; false for never_served or an explicitly absent current partner; otherwise unknown.
derived_fields.recent_focal_return: For a member, derive only from Q9. For a spouse or other-family respondent, derive only from Q10. Yes = true, No = false, missing = unknown. With unresolved role, retain unknown; never use whichever deployment answer happens to be positive.
derived_fields.young_dependent_child_gate: Use the Part 1 age-22-or-younger dependant gate from Q8. Positive valid counts in any under-23 row establish true; explicit no_dependants or all four relevant Number totals explicitly zero establish false; otherwise unknown. L-CHILD alone cannot make this gate true.
derived_fields.independent_child_gate: L-CHILD yes = true, no = false, skipped/prefer = unknown.
derived_fields.child_route_eligible: young_dependent_child_gate OR independent_child_gate, preserving the Part 1 child-route extension and unknown handling.
derived_fields.employment_role: True for Q3 civilian_spouse, civilian_partner or former_bereaved_partner; false for known member, adult_child, parent or other_family roles; otherwise unknown.
derived_fields.outside_defence_housing: False for Q57 defence_on_base or defence_off_base; true for civilian_owned or civilian_rented; unknown for friends_family, other_housing or skipped.
derived_fields.rank_menu: Q4 army -> army; navy -> navy; air_force -> air_force; other_country, unsure, none or skipped -> other_or_unknown.
derived_fields.rank_reference: last_before_death for a deceased focal member; otherwise last_at_exit for a known former member; otherwise current. This records the question's reference point, not proof of current service.
derived_fields.rank_stem: Use self_current/self_last_at_exit for a known member. Otherwise use family_current/family_last_at_exit/family_last_before_death according to rank_reference.
derived_fields.background_intro_variant: single_member only for a member with current_partner = false; otherwise family.
derived_fields.focal_referent: self for a member; spouse_partner for a civilian spouse/partner; other_family for other-family or unresolved roles.
derived_fields.focal_duration_referent: deceased for a deceased focal member; otherwise use focal_referent.
derived_fields.self_or_family_referent: self for a known member; otherwise family.
derived_fields.member_or_spouse_referent: member for a known member; spouse for a civilian spouse/partner. If role is unresolved and an item remains optionally available, use its spouse variant and preserve role_unknown with the presented variant; never analyse this fallback as established spouse eligibility.
derived_fields.partner_scope: without_partner only when current_partner = false; otherwise with_partner.

gates.recent_focal_return: Use recent_focal_return, including other-family proxy respondents.
gates.Q53_explicit_yes: Q53 is active and explicitly yes.
gates.Q60_explicit_yes: Q60 is active and explicitly yes.
gates.partnered_member_attitudes_not_retiring: member_current_service_attitudes AND current_partner AND NOT explicit_retirement(Q65).
gates.role_established: Q3 establishes member, spouse/partner or other-family role; an unresolved Q3 does not activate member/spouse proxy wording.
gates.known_member_with_military_partner: Established member role and applicable current partner/military partner condition; unresolved role is hidden.
gates.known_role_recent_focal_return: Established respondent role and recent focal member return; unresolved role is hidden.
gates.known_member_or_spouse_partner_recent_re: Established member or spouse role, current partner and recent return; unknown partner/deployment within established role remains optional.
gates.children_any_age_optional: Q52 remains optionally available for respondents with children of any age; Q18 age-22 gate does not exclude it.
gates.known_member_or_spouse_recent_return_dep: Established member/spouse role, recent return and dependants of any age; explicit no dependants excludes; older or uncertain dependants leave item optional.
gates.known_civilian_or_former_partner_employm: Established civilian spouse/partner or former/bereaved partner role only.
gates.known_spouse_current_service_attitudes: Established spouse/partner role and current focal service; unknown service status within that role remains optional.
gates.known_spouse_attitudes_not_retiring: Established spouse/partner role, current service and no explicit retirement answer at Q63.
gates.known_member_current_service_attitudes: Established self-reporting member role and current service; unknown service status within that role remains optional.
gates.known_partnered_member_attitudes_not_ret: Established member role, current partner/current service and no explicit retirement answer at Q65.

deployment.Q42: Focal member's total deployment months falling within the past three years; not restricted to Greater Darwin deployments or recent return.
deployment.Q43: Only the member respondent's military spouse/partner exposure. A veteran partner can qualify. Do not repeat Q42 for civilian-spouse respondents.
deployment.Q44: Recent focal return gate; ask the length of that latest completed deployment.
deployment.Q45_Q46: Recent return plus the member/spouse and current-partner gates. Known single members and other-family respondents do not acquire these spouse-route items.
deployment.Q46_scale: Yes and No for both routes. I don’t know only when the respondent is a known member reporting the partner's attendance.
deployment.Q46_interpretation: No does not distinguish a briefing not offered from a briefing offered but not attended.
deployment.timeframes: Keep three-year exposure, latest completed deployment length and time since return separate.
deployment.definition: Do not broaden deployment to every training exercise, posting or period apart.

caring_and_employment.Q51: All adults, using their own current partnership for the stem; no co-residence requirement.
caring_and_employment.Q52: Use the same child gate as Part 1, including independent children. If unknown, show the supplied For respondents with children. instruction.
caring_and_employment.Q53: Use the dependent-child gate, not the independent-child extension alone; preserve formal custody/guardianship rather than informal childcare.
caring_and_employment.Q54: Only explicit Q53 yes. No or skipped bypasses Q54, retaining distinct answer states.
caring_and_employment.Q55_Q56: Civilian current and former/bereaved spouse/partner self-report. Member respondents, including dual-military members, and other relatives do not receive an extra spouse employment questionnaire.
caring_and_employment.hours: Numeric answers concern respondent work or attendance, not a partner's hours and not total independent study time.

housing.Q57: Respondent's current home, including outside Greater Darwin. Defence rent assistance does not turn a civilian rental into a Service residence.
housing.Q58: Skip explicit Defence housing. Show for civilian owned/rented housing. With friends/family, Other or skipped Q57, retain optional access with the supplied outside-Defence-housing instruction.
housing.Q58_boundaries: Under 30 minutes; at least 30 but under 60 minutes; 1–2 hours inclusive of exactly 2 hours; more than 2 hours.
housing.Q59: All adults; record their actual posting-related move, not only a posting order or someone else's move.
housing.Q60: Recent partnered member/spouse route only. Render the Not applicable option using the same person as the question.
housing.Q61: Only explicit Q60 yes. No, Not applicable and skipped bypass it but remain different states.

attitudes.former_deceased: Skip current-service attitudes. Do not code previous departure as favouring leaving.
attitudes.other_family: Do not convert spouse/member attitudes into parent, adult-child or carer attitudes; proceed to Q67.
attitudes.dual_military: Use the member route about the respondent's own service.
attitudes.reserves: Current Reserve membership remains military service; it is not evidence of leaving.
attitudes.unknown_service_status: Keep the role-appropriate section optional with the supplied current-service applicability instruction.
attitudes.skipped_preferences: Skipped Q63 or Q65 does not establish retirement.
attitudes.Q66_partner: Never required and never shown for an explicitly absent current partner.
attitudes.Q67: Always available after adult consent, including no problems, no help needed, skipped chains and inapplicable attitudes.

numeric_and_missing_answers.dont_know_exclusivity: A numeric value and Don’t know cannot coexist. Selecting either clears the active alternative, without converting unknown to zero.
numeric_and_missing_answers.age: Age is respondent age at last birthday, not focal-member age or a new eligibility gate.
numeric_and_missing_answers.full_time_zero: Q38 zero may mean no full-time service or less than one completed year; do not distinguish those from zero alone.
numeric_and_missing_answers.choice_nonresponse: Do not add Not sure or Prefer not to say to items that lack them in the supplied adaptation; optional skipping remains available.

demographic_and_option_rules.Q39: Reported sex, not sex at birth, gender identity or transgender status; no inference from other answers.
demographic_and_option_rules.Q49: No is exclusive; the two Yes options can coexist. Store under RAND_A_Q49_AU_indigenous_status.
demographic_and_option_rules.Q50: Allow all selected ancestries and Other text; no two-choice restriction. Store under RAND_A_Q50_AU_ancestry.
demographic_and_option_rules.citizenship_language: Do not use Q47 to infer visa/service eligibility or Q48 to infer English proficiency/interpreter need.
demographic_and_option_rules.education: Do not map broad Q41 groups automatically to AQF levels or formal overseas-equivalence outcomes.
demographic_and_option_rules.rank: Use Australian/local rank IDs and raw write-in text; no automatic US paygrade or cross-service equivalence mapping.

answer_targets.Q43: Respondent's military spouse/partner, distinct from the member respondent.
answer_targets.Q46: Member route: spouse/partner's attendance, reported by the member. Spouse route: respondent's own attendance.
answer_targets.Q51: Respondent's caring responsibilities; include respondent's spouse/partner under the with-partner stem.
answer_targets.Q52: Respondent's children receiving the specified services.
answer_targets.Q53_Q54: Respondent's dependants and formal custody during the focal member's latest completed deployment; Q54 relationships are relative to the respondent.
answer_targets.Q60_Q61: Member route: spouse/partner's relocation. Spouse route: respondent's relocation.
answer_targets.Q62_Q63: Civilian spouse/partner's own views about the focal member's current service.
answer_targets.Q64: Civilian spouse/partner's perception of the focal member's preference.
answer_targets.Q65: Currently serving member respondent's own preference.
answer_targets.Q66: Member respondent's perception of the spouse/partner's preference about the respondent's service.

provenance.serialization_basis: The complete reviewed adaptation supplied in this request. No new PDF, local-file, code, frontend or respondent-test inspection is claimed.
provenance.option_number_policy: Retain source numbers where given. Null marks unnumbered columns, locally added choices or replacement menus; it is not an inferred original code.

Q37.note: Current rank replaces US paygrade; Australian branch menus and generic foreign/unknown menu. Known former/deceased members receive explicit last-rank variants.

Q38.note: Full-time service replaces active duty; include continuous full-time Reserve service and retain completed years and Don’t know.

Q39.note: Reported-sex stem and an additional term replace ambiguous Are you wording; not an equivalent gender or sex-at-birth measure.

Q40.note: Retain respondent age at last birthday in whole completed years.

Q41.note: Six broad Australian school/qualification groups plus Other; not AQF-level or credential-equivalence codes.

Q42.note: Retain total months in the past three years, with the supplied member/spouse/other-family referents.

Q43.note: Retain separate partner deployment exposure; extend to unmarried and formerly serving military partners.

Q44.note: Retain latest completed deployment length and recent focal-return gate.

Q45.note: Retain time since return and printed married restriction, extended to current partners; no other-family route.

Q46.note: Retain before/during/since matrix; partner extension and proxy-only uncertainty.

Q47.note: Australian citizenship replaces United States citizenship; omit unconfirmed research-only and benefit-eligibility explanation.

Q48.note: Retain the exact English-as-a-second-language question; no proficiency inference.

Q49.note: Australian Indigenous status replaces the US Hispanic/Latino construct. Separate local variable; no mapping of original Yes/No codes.

Q50.note: Australian ancestry replaces the US race checklist. Multiple responses retained without a two-response cap; separate local variable.

Q51.note: Caring, older family member and disability terminology; extend spouse to partner while retaining examples.

Q52.note: Retain special education/early intervention receipt; omit only the US Exceptional Family Member Program clause and use the Part 1 child route.

Q53.note: Retain formal custody/guardianship, dependent-child and recent-deployment gates.

Q54.note: Former spouse or partner and Partner (not married) replace source relationship labels; spouse respondent refers to the service member's deployment.

Q55.note: Retain exact self-report weekly work-hours question; local route includes civilian current and former/bereaved spouse/partner respondents.

Q56.note: Use school, TAFE, university or another education/training institution; preserve attendance hours.

Q57.note: Australian Defence/civilian housing labels and an added Other arrangement; preserve source housing distinctions.

Q58.note: Retain nearest-base travel-time construct; include exactly 30 minutes in the second category and preserve exactly two hours in the third.

Q59.note: Replace PCS with an actual posting-related move between bases or posting locations.

Q60.note: Partner extension; spouse stem includes the local area and its Not applicable choice refers to I.

Q61.note: Retain all thirteen reasons; Defence housing, partner referents and Australian spelling only.

Q62.note: Retain five support choices for civilian spouses/partners of currently serving members.

Q63.note: Retain six choices and retirement skip; Australian favour spelling.

Q64.note: Retain perceived member preference and Don’t know; Australian favour spelling.

Q65.note: Retain own-service preferences and retiring-soon skip, including current Reserve members.

Q66.note: Retain perceived spouse preference, extend to partners and preserve retirement/partnership gates.

Q67.note: Retain original closing comment verbatim, optional multiline COMMENTS field and availability to everyone.

measurement_limits: Australian ranks are not established US paygrade equivalents; retain raw rank and current/last-at-exit/last-before-death reference points.
Broad Q41 categories are not formal AQF-level codes or overseas qualification assessments.
Q49 and Q50 are Australian replacement constructs, not statistically equivalent versions of the US items.
Q64 and Q66 report perceptions of another person's preference, not that person's direct answer.
Q62–Q66 are service-attitude indicators, not actual retention, general satisfaction or a resilience score.
Do not use detailed cross-tabulations of rank, age, ancestry, household and need pathways to report identifiable tiny groups.
